chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr who said:
I asked al-Rida (peace be upon him): Is it permissible to have temporary marriage (mut'ah) with a slave girl with the permission of her owners? He said: Yes.
Indeed, Allah the Exalted says: 'So marry them with the permission of their owners.'

key_terms.الرِّضَا ع: Al-Rida (peace be upon him), referring to Imam Ali al-Rida
key_terms.بِإِذْنِ أَهْلِهَا: With the permission of her owners

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for temporary marriage with a slave girl in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-istibsar, Imam al-Rida (AS) confirms the permissibility of temporary marriage (mut'ah) with a slave girl, contingent upon the owner's consent. He substantiates this ruling by citing Quran 4:25, linking the specific condition of 'permission of their masters' directly to the broader command to marry them, thereby grounding the juristic principle in explicit scriptural evidence.
